title: 1954 Entering Grade 1
description: This group entered Grade 1 in 1954 and eventually graduated as the class of 1966. Left doorway: unknown, Rheta Lovely, Dorothy MacLeod, Elsa Keith. Right doorway: unknown, unknown, unknown. Front row (left facing): Eugene Craig, unknown, unknown, Michael Hatfield. Second row: Kerry Crabbe, unknown, Ralph Dickinson, Susan Hatfield, Elaine Albright, Stephen Rideout. Third row: Wanda Whitehouse, Wayne Clark (standing), Allison Glass, Nancy Lovely, Ann MacLeod (hand up), Carol Rideout. Standing: Barbara Rideout, Wanda Hovey.
